remarks: Welcome to 18 East Street in Gainesville! This 3-bedroom home offers plenty of space, versatility, and a standout 24' x 46' pole barn to which can garage 4 or more vehicles, all situated on approximately 0.6 acres. The first floor features a convenient laundry room, half bath, Kitchen, dining area, Living room and a bonus room offering flexible space for a home office or playroom. Sliding glass doors of the dining area lead to the deck and backyard, providing easy access to the impressive pole barn. Built in 2020, the 1,104 sq. ft. pole barn features concrete floors and electric, 3bays with electric garage door openers, generous space for vehicle parking, equipment, storage, a workshop, or recreational gear. Now Back to the house, the kitchen is well- lit, has ample cupboard space and appliances are included, featuring a gas range, refrigerator, newer microwave, and newer dishwasher.  Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms a Full bathrm, along with an additional bonus room that could serve as a hobby area, or storage space. Additional features include a full basement, central air conditioning, and a newer furnace approximately four years old.  With flexible living and storage spaces, a spacious village lot including a garden bed, apples tree, and an exceptional newer pole barn, this property has plenty to offer! This property Has two driveways for extra parking and easy access!  Great location convenient Gainsville Store is within a couple minutes for Pizza and Subs, the central school is only 1.5 miles away and Letchworth State Park is less than a 15 minute Drive away.
